component.name: mcp-server-snipeit
component.summary: MCP server for the Snipe-IT asset management system

description.p: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes the Snipe-IT REST API as tools for an LLM agent, built on fastmcp. It runs over stdio and is registered into a local mcprack catalog by its companion package.
Tools cover assets, consumables, accessories, components, licenses, users, locations, models, kits, custom fields, imports and reports. A read-only mode refuses every state-changing action.
